_doc: Items. 'balls': catch_mult multiplies the species catch rate (Gen 6+), guaranteed = always catches, top/accent = ball colours. 'items': everything else — category (medicine / berries / battle / key), price in Poké Dollars, effect = what using it does (hp = HP restored, 'full' = all; cure = status cured or 'all'; level = levels gained). icon = procedural icon for the UI (shape spray | vial | berry | candy, color); balls are drawn from top/accent.

balls.name: Poké Ball
balls.description: A device for catching wild Pokémon.

balls.name: Great Ball
balls.description: A good, high-performance Poké Ball with a higher catch rate than a standard one.

balls.name: Premier Ball
balls.description: A rare ball made in commemoration of some event.

balls.name: Ultra Ball
balls.description: An ultra-high-performance ball with a higher catch rate than a Great Ball.

balls.name: Master Ball
balls.description: The best ball. It catches any wild Pokémon without fail.

items.name: Potion
items.description: Restores the HP of one Pokémon by 20 points.

items.name: Super Potion
items.description: Restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

items.name: Burn Heal
items.description: Heals a Pokémon of a burn.

items.name: Escape Rope
items.description: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape from a cave or dungeon.

items.name: Repel
items.description: Repels weak wild Pokémon for 100 steps.

items.name: Oran Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it heals 10 HP when its HP drops low.

items.name: Pecha Berry
items.description: If held by a Pokémon, it cures poisoning.

items.name: Rare Candy
items.description: A candy packed with energy. It raises the level of a single Pokémon by one.

items.name: Ether
items.description: Restores the PP of one move. (PP restoring is not implemented yet.)

items.name: Oak's Parcel
items.description: A package to be delivered to Prof. Oak.

items.name: Pokédex
items.description: Records the Pokémon you see and catch.

items.name: Teachy TV
items.description: A portable TV that teaches you how to catch and battle with Pokémon.

items.name: HM05 Flash
items.description: Lights up even the darkest of caves. (HMs are not implemented yet.)
